o1: Predicted to enable protein phosphatase activator activity and protein phosphatase regulator activity. Involved in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II; innate immune response; defense response to bacterium; negative regulation of mitotic DNA damage checkpoint; response to UV; and response to X-ray. Located in nucleus. Is expressed in anal depressor muscle; excretory cell; intestine; nervous system; and pharynx. Interacts with PPH-4.1. Orthologous to several human genes including PPP4R3A (protein phosphatase 4 regulatory subunit 3A) and PPP4R3B (protein phosphatase 4 regulatory subunit 3B).
